title: Jets can remove any caveats with a statement-making win against Packers

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Jets can remove any caveats with a statement-making win against Packers
sources.description: The Jets impressed people in Sunday’s 23-10 over the Titans. But as impressive as the Jets were, every evaluation of that game seems to come with a “but” as in, “but it came against the Titans.”
